title: Genesis Bible Quiz - Chapter 5
description: Ten questions on Genesis 5: the generations from Adam to Noah and how long each of them lived.

questions.text: What name did God give to man and woman on the day they were created?
questions.explanation: He created them male and female, blessed them, and on the day they were created he named them Adam.

questions.text: How old was Adam when he became the father of Seth?
questions.explanation: Adam lived one hundred thirty years, and became the father of a son in his own likeness, and named him Seth.

questions.text: How many years did Adam live in all?
questions.explanation: All the days that Adam lived were nine hundred thirty years, then he died.

questions.text: Who was the son of Enosh?
questions.explanation: Enosh lived ninety years, and became the father of Kenan.

questions.text: What did Enoch do for three hundred years after Methuselah's birth?
questions.explanation: After Methuselah's birth, Enoch walked with God for three hundred years, and had more sons and daughters.

questions.text: What happened to Enoch at the end of his days?
questions.explanation: Enoch walked with God, and he was not found, for God took him.

answers.text: He was not found, for God took him
He was driven out to the land of Nod
He was killed in the field

questions.text: Who lived nine hundred sixty-nine years?
questions.explanation: All the days of Methuselah were nine hundred sixty-nine years, then he died.

questions.text: What did Lamech say about his son Noah when he named him?
questions.explanation: Lamech said, "This one will comfort us in our work and in the toil of our hands, caused by the ground which Yahweh has cursed."

answers.text: He would build a great ship
He would rule over the earth
He would comfort them in their work

questions.text: How many years did Lamech, the father of Noah, live in all?
questions.explanation: All the days of Lamech were seven hundred seventy-seven years, then he died.

questions.text: How old was Noah when he became the father of Shem, Ham, and Japheth?
questions.explanation: Noah was five hundred years old, then he became the father of Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
